summary.name: SFXMint
summary.one_liner: SFXMint is a free library of CC0 sound effects (whooshes, clicks, footsteps, impacts, ambience) for videos, games and apps, with MP3 downloads and no signup.
use_cases: Adding sound effects to a YouTube video
Finding game sounds like jump, coin or hit for a platformer
Giving an app UI taps, alerts and menu sounds
Letting an AI coding assistant pull sounds into a game project
Downloading CC0 sounds for a commercial game or ad
summary.what_it_does: SFXMint is a library of CC0 sound effects organized into 23 categories, including interface sounds, water sounds, footsteps and named sound sets. Each file can be played in the browser and shows its length before download. Free users can download MP3s without signing up, subject to a daily limit. The site also offers a JSON API and an MCP server so tools like Claude Code, Cursor and Codex can fetch sounds directly into a project, with a get_sound_set call for ready-made sets. Every file is said to be checked for format, length, loudness and peak level.
notable: CC0 licence: no attribution or license fee needed, including for commercial games
MCP server and REST API let AI coding assistants add sounds to a project
Browser preview with file length shown before download
Sounds are AI-generated or synthesized, which Steam and itch.io ask developers to disclose
caveats: Free tier limited to 3 MP3 downloads a day; WAV, unlimited downloads and API/MCP use require a download pack that lasts 30 days from payment
Sounds are AI-generated or synthesized and must be disclosed on Steam and itch.io
Free MCP/REST use is capped at 20 lookups and 5 downloads a day
